task.scg2_maid_compat.medic_heal.desc: Uses the Crusader and healing bandages to heal a wounded owner, fellow maids, and same-faction units
task.scg2_maid_compat.medic_heal.conditi: Holding a Crusader or medical item
chat_bubble.scg2_maid_compat.wrong_item_: Give me a grenade! I can't use this one...
chat_bubble.scg2_maid_compat.heal_use.0: Hold still, let me bandage you up~

Don't worry, Master, I can handle it myself~
Hiss... it stings a little, just bear with it.
chat_bubble.scg2_maid_compat.heal_self_d: Phew... there, my tail can still wag~

chat_bubble.scg2_maid_compat.spot.2: Uwu, some bad guys are coming!
chat_bubble.scg2_maid_compat.fire.3: Bang! Just like popping a wine bottle~

advancements.scg2_maid_compat.scg2_kill_: A maid kills a mob with a Scorched Guns 2 weapon

Have a maid kill 100 illagers with a laser musket

scg2_maid_compat.config.text_4: Maid gun attack accuracy (higher is more accurate). Spread = 5 x difficulty / this value.
scg2_maid_compat.config.tick_2: Number of ticks the maid retreats after throwing a grenade.
scg2_maid_compat.config.text_14: Maximum melee reach for stock and bayonet attacks (blocks).
scg2_maid_compat.config.text_16: Movement speed multiplier while closing in for melee.
scg2_maid_compat.config.text_18: When enabled, the maid uses a bayonet sweep melee, with animation, once a target is within melee range.
scg2_maid_compat.config.tick_3: Extra ticks added between shots (0 = the gun's natural rate, 20 = one shot per second). Higher values save ammo.
scg2_maid_compat.config.text_22: Line infantry: maids carrying antique weapons hold position, form up in front of their owner and volley fire.
scg2_maid_compat.config.tick_4: Interval between volleys (ticks). Every line infantry maid fires on this rhythm.
scg2_maid_compat.config.text_26: Maximum number of maids in a line formation.
scg2_maid_compat.config.text_28: Horizontal spacing between maids in formation (blocks).
scg2_maid_compat.config.text_31: When enabled, the maid reloads without consuming ammo from her inventory and ignores ammo requirements entirely.
scg2_maid_compat.config.text_39: Target search radius for sniper rifles (blocks).
scg2_maid_compat.config.scg: Makes the maid lead moving targets on every difficulty (SCG only did so on Hard).
scg2_maid_compat.config.scg_2: How much the lead direction is mixed into aiming (SCG default 0.3, 1.0 = full lead).
scg2_maid_compat.config.text_55: Maximum distance the maid may walk while searching (blocks). Beyond this she gives up the target instead.
scg2_maid_compat.config.scg_extra_player: SCG Extra integration: puts players and maids into their own faction "player", which SCG Extra faction mobs will attack.
scg2_maid_compat.config.scg_extra_n: SCG Extra integration: when mobs of the same faction shoot each other, bullets pass through allies without friendly fire\n(player and maid projectiles are unaffected).
scg2_maid_compat.config.gunattackgoal_sc: Movement speed multiplier passed to GunAttackGoal (SC2's gunner mobs use 1.0).
